name: Niinami Misono
source:
A science teacher at the school. She is always wearing a white lab coat when at school. She is intelligent and has a good teaching style, so the level of science at the school has improved since she took up her position.
However, she has some personality issues and is an eccentric person, so the students keep their distance from her. She took up her post at Seiryo Academy for "a certain purpose".
"She is the person who will expose the true nature that Akio keeps hidden..."

[Translated from the [url=http://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc032/character/misono.htmll]official site[/url]]
